matches_participants_check.name: matches_participants_check
matches_participants_check.value:
("matches"."tournament_id" is not null and ("matches"."player1_id" is not null or "matches"."player2_id" is not null or "matches"."pending_player2_id" is not null))
        or ("matches"."tournament_id" is null and "matches"."player1_id" is not null and (
          ("matches"."player2_id" is not null and "matches"."pending_player2_id" is null)
          or ("matches"."player2_id" is null and "matches"."pending_player2_id" is not null)))

tournament_matches_bye_check.name: tournament_matches_bye_check
tournament_matches_bye_check.value: ("tournament_matches"."is_bye" = false and "tournament_matches"."match_id" is not null) or ("tournament_matches"."is_bye" = true and "tournament_matches"."player_id" is not null)
